epic.summary: [makato] Agentic Orchestration — autonomous control plane for makato build/plan workflows
epic.objective: Add autonomous orchestration to makato: plan → build → review → merge with minimal human in the loop, using R1 contracts, kill-switches, and resumable workflow state

description.background: Backfilled from GitHub issue #28 (GAP-009). See the issue body for full context.
description.scope: The current `coder.md` and `build-verify.md` each carry implicit DoD criteria embedded in prose. There is no canonical, versioned list of done criteria shared across agents. This means the PO-agent cannot programmatically assert "this task is done" without re-reading every agent's prose. A declarative DoD with a machine-checkable automated tier and a human-verification tier closes this gap.
